question: What was the average length in months of marketable interest-bearing public debt held by private investors at end of the most recent fiscal year?

rule_gen.notes: Final rule prioritizes strict FD-5 title detection with latest fiscal-year row extraction, plus a chart fallback for the 1995 layout. Working sample was shifted to the later, stable OCR/table era after early broad-sample verification exposed degraded pre-1990 layouts.
